title: Indirect calorimetry
summary: Indirect calorimetry is the preferred method for determining energy expenditure when available.

title: ASPEN early ICU energy range
summary: ASPEN suggests 12-25 kcal/kg/day during the first 7-10 ICU days; use a clinician-selected dosing weight.

title: ESPEN protein target
summary: Protein delivery around 1.3 g/kg/day should be delivered progressively in critically ill adults.

title: ASPEN 2022 protein evidence
summary: The focused ASPEN update found insufficient evidence to issue a new protein-dose recommendation; older guidance should be identified as legacy when shown.

title: Early EN
summary: When oral intake is not possible in the applicable critically ill adult population early EN should generally be initiated within 48 hours.

title: Maximum carbohydrate administration
summary: Carbohydrate administration should not exceed the guideline maximum glucose delivery rate.

title: IV lipid ceiling
summary: IV lipid including non-nutritional lipid sources should not exceed the stated maximum and should be adjusted to tolerance.

title: Refeeding hypophosphatemia trigger
summary: ESPEN identifies refeeding hypophosphatemia using low phosphate or a clinically important phosphate fall and recommends intensified electrolyte monitoring.

title: Body mass index
summary: Standard BMI calculation.

title: Weir equation
summary: Calculate energy expenditure from oxygen consumption and carbon dioxide production when appropriate measurements are available.

title: Glucose infusion rate
summary: Convert daily glucose exposure to a weight-normalized minute rate.

title: Nitrogen intake
summary: Estimate nitrogen intake from protein intake.

title: Nitrogen balance
summary: Estimate nitrogen balance using UUN plus an explicit estimate of non-urinary nitrogen losses.

title: NPC:N ratio
summary: Calculate non-protein calories per gram nitrogen.

title: kcal to kJ
summary: Energy conversion.

title: kJ to kcal
summary: Energy conversion.

title: Devine IBW — male
summary: Common adult ideal-body-weight estimate. This is a calculation convention, not a universal ICU dosing-weight recommendation.

title: Devine IBW — female
summary: Common adult ideal-body-weight estimate. This is a calculation convention, not a universal ICU dosing-weight recommendation.

title: Adjusted body weight
summary: Common adjusted-weight convention. Use only when the selected guideline/protocol calls for it; the correction factor is not universal.

title: Percentage weight loss
summary: Calculate percentage loss from usual to current body weight. Interpret with timeframe and clinical context.

title: Weight-based fluid estimate
summary: Generic weight-based fluid arithmetic. This is an estimate only and not an ICU fluid prescription; account for organ function, losses, inputs and resuscitation status.

title: Formula free-water delivery
summary: Calculate water delivered from a product using verified product water content.

title: Daily fluid balance
summary: Arithmetic balance of measured inputs and outputs; missing components should remain missing rather than assumed zero.

title: Sodium mmol ↔ mEq
summary: For monovalent sodium, numeric mmol and mEq values are equal.

title: Potassium mmol ↔ mEq
summary: For monovalent potassium, numeric mmol and mEq values are equal.

title: mmol ↔ mEq by valence
summary: For an ion, mEq depends on ionic valence; do not apply monovalent conversions to calcium or magnesium.

title: IV dextrose energy
summary: Energy from parenteral dextrose uses 3.4 kcal per gram.

title: Amino-acid energy
summary: Common PN macronutrient accounting uses approximately 4 kcal per gram of amino acids/protein.

title: IV lipid energy
summary: Use the verified energy density of the actual lipid emulsion/product; do not assume all lipid emulsions have the same kcal/mL.

title: Total PN energy
summary: Sum verified energy contributions from dextrose, amino acids and lipid; include other energy sources separately when relevant.
formula: dextrose kcal + amino-acid kcal + lipid kcal

title: Respiratory quotient
summary: Calculate RQ from simultaneous VCO2 and VO2 measurements; interpretation requires valid steady-state measurements.

title: VCO2-based EE estimate
summary: A VCO2-derived estimate is an estimate rather than measured indirect calorimetry; use the equation specified by the selected protocol/source.

title: Prefer measured energy expenditure
summary: ESPEN ICU guidance prefers indirect calorimetry for determining energy expenditure when available.

title: Individualize nutrition in AKI/CKD
summary: Hospitalized patients with acute or chronic kidney disease require nutrition assessment and therapy adapted to kidney function, illness severity and kidney replacement therapy context.

title: Account for KRT-related nutrient losses
summary: Kidney replacement therapy can alter nutrient and micronutrient losses. Use the kidney guideline and local KRT modality information rather than a single universal replacement value.

title: Refeeding electrolyte monitoring
summary: In patients with refeeding hypophosphatemia, ESPEN ICU guidance supports intensified monitoring of phosphate, potassium and magnesium while nutrition progression is reassessed.

title: Treat documented/suspected deficiency contextually
summary: Micronutrient supplementation should account for clinical context, deficiency risk, route, organ function and potential toxicity; avoid assuming that high-dose supplementation is routinely beneficial.

title: Micronutrients with PN
summary: Complete PN requires attention to vitamins and trace elements rather than macronutrients alone; product composition and duration should be reviewed.
